prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a hyper-realistic close-up portrait of a middle-aged man with a full, neatly groomed salt-and-pepper beard and short, slicked-back hair. The subject has striking blue eyes and a serious, contemplative expression, gazing directly into the camera to create an intense sense of connection with the viewer. He is wearing a plain white t-shirt, and the background is softly blurred, suggesting an indoor setting with muted colors—pale yellows, grays, and hints of glass or plastic surfaces, possibly an office or waiting room. The lighting is cool and even, highlighting the natural texture of the skin and beard without harsh shadows, lending a candid, documentary feel to the image. The composition is tightly framed, focusing on the face and upper shoulders, with a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject from the background, emphasizing emotional immediacy and realism.
